body: Rift Hound/Shambler Trooper/Gore Brute got real distinct abilities (dash, Frag Toss splash, Ground Slam splash) built on SHANKPIT's own existing combat mechanics, not invented systems. Added Storm Caller (real storm-charge sniper burst, previously reachable-but-unconsumed by any non-sniper weapon -- a real latent gap fixed) and Bombardier (real splash-AOE missile spammer) for genuine roster variety. Live-verified via a headless test harness exercising the real story_ai_tick loop (15/15 checks). Commit SHANKPIT 656106b.
title: Real abilities for story-mode enemies + 2 new threat roles
